review_candidates.title: Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Position Overview Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues. This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis. To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer’s business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc. Required Hours The hours required are from 11:30 AM IST - 8:30 PM IST (9 hours) for 5 days Participate in our on-call rotation that may include weekends and holidays. Role And Responsibilities Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages. Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team. Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing. Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness. Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction. Required Skills And Experience 4+ years of advanced customer-facing technical support experience. Experience with MySQL or MySQL-like (MariaDB, Aurora, etc) database and SQL Query Optimization. A solid Kubernetes and sysadmin skill set. Also, comfortable testing software and finding its limits, hands-on with Linux, checking utilization of system I/O, measuring network throughput, and are comfortable navigating large log files. Experience with a scripting or coding language. Whether it’s Python, Bash, or Go, you should have a go-to solution for quick and dirty problem-solving and be able to navigate through our code base. Familiarity with distributed systems and AWS/GCP. You understand how organizations deploy and maintain distributed applications and services across multiple machines Bonus points for knowing how to analyze them for performance bottlenecks and remove single points of failure. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have the ability to explain technical concepts to a wide range of end-users. SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people. To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company. SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we’re proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses. For candidates residing in California, please see our California Recruitment Privacy Notice . For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice. COG00073

Who We Are Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Job Description Job Family Definition Customer Solution Centers consist of teams that provide customer access, pre-sales, post-sales, technical support, and service delivery. Technical teams resolve business systems, infrastructure, and application issues for customers, onsite engineering personnel, and Authorized Service Providers across standard, specialized, and complex systems. This position is based in an engineering laboratory and focuses on hands-on technical investigation, testing, troubleshooting, and resolution of hardware, software, configuration, and system-integration issues. Management Level Definition Applies intermediate subject-matter knowledge to resolve a variety of common and moderately complex technical issues. Works independently within established practices, procedures, and policies. Analyzes information, evaluates unique circumstances, recommends appropriate actions, and engages additional technical resources when required. Provides informed team input and limited project-direction support. Responsibilities Investigate, reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, firmware, configuration, interoperability, and system-integration issues in an engineering laboratory. Set up, configure, test, and troubleshoot computing, storage, networking, peripheral, and related infrastructure systems. Analyze customer and field reported issues using logs, diagnostic tools, test results, product documentation, and laboratory resources. Develop and execute test plans to isolate faults, identify probable root causes, and validate corrective actions. Evaluate unique or complex installations, configurations, and system interactions and recommend appropriate resolutions. Validate workarounds, replacement components, firmware updates and configuration changes before recommending implementation. Perform approved component replacement, system rebuilds, reconfiguration, and other hands-on diagnostic activities. Respond to service, product, technical, and customer support questions regarding features, specifications, repairs, current and discontinued products, parts, and options. Provide support in accordance with applicable customer entitlement, including warranty, support contract, and mission-critical service coverage. Proactively identify recurring issues and recommend actions to prevent or reduce future problems. Maintain accurate and timely case records in approved case management and engineering systems. Document test conditions, system configurations, troubleshooting activities, root-cause findings, corrective actions, and validation results. Add validated case resolutions, procedures, and technical findings to the Knowledge Management System (KMS). Escalate suspected product defects, documentation gaps, recurring issues, and other concerns through established processes. Coordinate activities to support applicable service-level agreements, quality standards, escalation requirements, and customer commitments. Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and status updates clearly in writing and verbally. Represent the company professionally during approved customer-site visits, industry conferences, trade shows, vendor meetings, or technical reviews. Develop effective partnerships with and provide technical support to the Sales Pursuit team. Advocate for customer needs while balancing technical feasibility, service entitlement, security, safety, policy, and business requirements. Contribute to improvements in laboratory methods, troubleshooting processes, diagnostic tools, technical documentation, and customer-resolution quality. Education And Experience Required Vocational or technical certification, apprenticeship completion, associate degree, or equivalent practical experience. Experience in laboratory engineering, technical support, infrastructure support, systems engineering, field service, hardware troubleshooting, or a related technical environment. Experience setting up, configuring, testing, and troubleshooting computing, storage, networking, operating-system, or peripheral technologies. Relevant industry certifications or technical qualifications, where applicable to the assigned technology portfolio. Knowledge And Skills Demonstrated experience troubleshooting technical issues in a laboratory, engineering, infrastructure, or technical support environment. Working knowledge of computing, storage, networking, operating systems, peripherals, and related infrastructure. Ability to build, modify, test, and restore laboratory configurations accurately and safely. Ability to develop test plans, interpret test results, and document repeatable technical findings. Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency with diagnostic tools, test equipment, system logs, monitoring utilities, and technical documentation. Proficiency with case-management, engineering documentation, laboratory asset, and knowledge management systems. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain technical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to prioritize multiple investigations and manage work according to established timelines. Strong customer service and customer relationship skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, support, field service, service delivery, sales, and business teams. Ability to communicate effectively in the language is required for the assigned customer population or market. Ability to follow applicable laboratory equipment handling, security, environmental, and safety procedures. Working Conditions Regular presence in the engineering laboratory is required. The role may involve working with servers, storage systems, networking equipment, electronic components, racks, cabling, powered equipment, and other technical hardware. The position may require standing, walking, reaching, bending, and handling technical equipment within established safety and equipment handling limits. Occasional travel, customer-site visits, vendor meetings, industry events, or technical reviews may be required, depending on business needs.
